observations: Photo 0: Closed black laptop with 'ThinkPad' logo on the bottom right corner. The lid shows dust and smudges. A small sticker is visible on the top right. The Lenovo logo is faintly visible on the top left.

Photo 1: Open laptop showing keyboard with red TrackPoint, black keys, and a trackpad with orange trim. The bottom right corner has the 'ThinkPad' logo. A blue Intel sticker is visible on the bottom left of the palm rest.

Photo 2: Laptop open, screen on, displaying a blue Windows desktop background. A handwritten note is taped to the screen: 'LENOVO THINKPAD T480 CORE I5 8TH GEN 256 SSD 8GB RAM SCREEN'. The bottom right of the screen bezel has 'T480' printed. The keyboard and trackpad are visible below the screen. The laptop is on a wooden surface with a brick wall in the background.

claims.evidence: Photo 2: 'T480' printed on the screen bezel and handwritten note on screen.
Photo 2: Handwritten note says 'CORE I5 8TH GEN', but no visible hardware or BIOS screen to confirm. Intel sticker on photo 1 is generic and does not specify generation.
Photo 2: Handwritten note says '8GB RAM', but no system information or BIOS screen to confirm. RAM is not visible.
Photo 2: Handwritten note says '256 SSD', but no system information or BIOS screen to confirm. SSD is not visible.
Photo 2: Screen is on, but no visible touch indicators or gestures shown. The handwritten note does not mention touchscreen. The T480 model can have touchscreen, but it is not confirmed here.
Performance cannot be assessed from photos alone. No benchmark or usage video provided.
